title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics and parity bump v1.21.0
author: Aisha Patel
description: Summary: Unify authentication, retry behaviour, and streaming ergonomics across Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs. This PR consolidates auth token refresh logic, standardizes retry/exponential-backoff defaults, fixes streaming iterator ergonomics to match the JS/Go experience, and applies parity fixes across SDKs. Also bumps SDK package versions to v1.21.0 and updates changelogs. Motivation: inconsistent retry semantics and streaming surfaces were causing developer confusion and intermittent production mismatches across client languages. This change aligns semantics, improves observability for auth/retries, and preps the SDKs for the v1.21.0 release. Checklist: - [x] Consolidate auth token refresh and unified credentials provider - [x] Standardize retry policy (5xx and 429 handling, idempotency hints) - [x] Streaming API ergonomics: consistent iterator/async iterator behavior and cancelation hooks - [x] Parity fixes across Python/TS/Go (method names, error types, logging) - [x] Bump versions and update changelogs - [x] Add/adjust unit and integration tests - [x] Run E2E streaming tests and smoke tests. Detailed changes (high level): - Python SDK: refactor auth.Client -> auth.CredentialsProvider with refresh hooks, simplify user-facing retry options to retry_policy and max_retries, implement async streaming generator with .close() support and improved backpressure handling. - TypeScript SDK: introduce unified RetryPolicy type, normalize streaming ReadableStream wrapper to return AsyncIterable, add compatibility shims for legacy stream consumers. - Go SDK: adopt common retry middleware, centralize token refresh into credentials package, expose StreamClient with Context-based cancellation and consistent error wrapping. - Docs: update quickstart snippets across languages to show new auth flow and retry defaults. - Tests: add cross-language compatibility tests for streaming; extend retry unit tests with failure injection for 429/503 scenarios. Related work: Linear items ENG-3421 (SDK auth parity), ENG-3480 (retry standardization), PM-912 (release coordination). Links: see internal RFC: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-3421/sdk-auth-retry-parity and the release checklist: https://linear.app/redwood/board/PM-912/release-v1.21.0
